subject.title: feat(signal): add chat-based setup and account linking

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this PR as the single canonical Signal setup implementation and retire the parallel setup branch at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100906 after a current-main refresh?
rationale: The patch intentionally introduces a new cross-client hosted-setup capability and session-lifecycle contract, and its relationship to the still-open earlier Signal setup branch requires maintainer ownership rather than automated cleanup.

options.title: Adopt as canonical Signal setup
options.body: Refresh this branch against current `main`, verify upgrade behavior and legacy Gateway fallback on the merged surface, then use it as the only landing path for the Signal setup work.

options.title: Split the shared contract first
options.body: Land or review the generic hosted-wizard QR and lifecycle changes separately before deciding on the Signal plugin behavior.

options.title: Keep existing setup direction
options.body: Decline this cross-client direction and preserve the earlier or terminal-only setup path until a narrower proposal is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Adopt as canonical Signal setup
recommendation.body: Refresh this branch against current `main`, verify upgrade behavior and legacy Gateway fallback on the merged surface, then use it as the only landing path for the Signal setup work.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies this member as the continuing author of both Signal setup branches and the person best placed to provide implementation context for the maintainer decision.
